packageRules.description: Hold ESLint on the 9.x maintenance line. eslint-config-next pulls in eslint-plugin-react, whose latest release (7.37.5, 2025-04-03) caps its eslint peer at ^9.7 and crashes on v10 with 'contextOrFilename.getFilename is not a function'. Lift this cap once eslint-plugin-react ships ESLint 10 support (jsx-eslint/eslint-plugin-react#3977).
